rules.name: ILODriveUnhealthy
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, Attributes['location'] AS drive, Attributes['model'] AS model, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_storage_disk_healthy' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host, drive, model ORDER BY time
rules.description: ilo_storage_disk_healthy is 0 for this drive. Check the array controller and replace the drive if it has failed.

rules.name: ILODriveFailurePredicted
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, Attributes['location'] AS drive, Attributes['model'] AS model, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_storage_disk_failure_predicted' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host, drive, model ORDER BY time
rules.description: The drive reports a predicted failure. Replace it before it fails.

rules.name: ILOPowerSupplyUnhealthy
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, Attributes['serial'] AS serial, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_power_supply_healthy' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host, serial ORDER BY time
rules.description: ilo_power_supply_healthy is 0; redundancy is lost or a PSU has failed.

rules.name: ILOMemoryUnhealthy
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, Attributes['name'] AS dimm, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_memory_dimm_healthy' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host, dimm ORDER BY time

rules.name: ILOProcessorUnhealthy
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, Attributes['socket'] AS socket, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_processor_healthy' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host, socket ORDER BY time

rules.name: ILOFanUnhealthy
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, Attributes['name'] AS fan, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_chassis_fan_healthy' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host, fan ORDER BY time

rules.name: ILOTemperatureUnhealthy
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, Attributes['name'] AS sensor, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_chassis_temperature_healthy' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host, sensor ORDER BY time

rules.name: ILOServerDown
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_power_up' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY host ORDER BY time
rules.summary: iLO {{ $labels.host }}: server is powered off or its iLO cannot be queried
rules.description: ilo_power_up is 0. The exporter either sees the server powered off or could not authenticate/reach the iLO (check the ilocredentials secret and ilo-prometheus logs).

rules.name: ILOMetricsMissing
rules.sql: SELECT max(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['host'] AS host, dateDiff('minute', max(TimeUnix), now()) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'ilo_power_up' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY host ORDER BY time
rules.summary: iLO {{ $labels.host }}: no metrics received for over an hour
rules.description: No ilo_power_up sample for this host in the last hour (scrape interval is 15m). Check ilo-collector, ilo-prometheus and otel-gateway.
